items.text: The board will convene on Tuesday at 10:00 in the Harborview Room to review the Q2 financials and approve the updated travel policy.
Due to the ongoing data migration, the booking system will be read-only from 8 PM Friday to 6 AM Saturday; please plan your reservations accordingly.

Our team is currently migrating customer profiles to the new CRM platform. During this period, some historical booking records may not be immediately visible. We appreciate your patience and will notify you once the migration is complete. For urgent matters, please contact support directly.

Weather conditions have caused significant shipping delays across the Midwest region. Orders placed between March 1 and March 5 may arrive 3-5 days later than originally estimated. We are working closely with our carriers to minimize further disruption. Affected customers will receive updated tracking information via email.
The board meeting agenda includes a demo of the new AI travel assistant, which will help employees book trips more efficiently.
Our automated chatbot is available 24/7 to answer common questions about bookings and cancellations.
Data migration schedule: Phase 1 (Jan 15-20) – user accounts; Phase 2 (Jan 21-25) – booking history; Phase 3 (Jan 26-31) – payment methods.

Shipping Delay Notice

Due to severe weather in the Midwest, shipments to Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio may be delayed by 2-4 business days. We apologize for any inconvenience and are monitoring the situation closely. Affected customers will receive updated tracking information.

Board Meeting Update

The quarterly board meeting originally scheduled for March 15 has been moved to March 22 at 2 PM. All department heads should prepare their reports accordingly. The meeting will be held virtually via Zoom; a link will be sent separately.

Data Migration Complete

We are pleased to announce that the migration of customer data to the new cloud-based reservation system is now complete. All historical bookings, profiles, and preferences have been transferred successfully. Users may notice a brief downtime tonight from 1-3 AM for final synchronization. Thank you for your patience during this transition.
The board has approved the budget for the upcoming fiscal year, including funds for upgrading our AI chatbot and data migration tools.

We are aware of a shipping delay affecting some orders placed last week. Our automated tracking system has been updated, and customers can check the latest status via their account dashboard. We apologize for any inconvenience.
